decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those as identified in the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southeast wall of both extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The window formed in the southeast elevation shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of part single storey rear extension, part single storey rear conservatory and installation of timber decking at rear
